model_annotation: This bar chart illustrates the number of participants associated with different criteria. The horizontal axis represents the criteria and is labeled “Criterion”, with categories listed alphabetically from bottom to top: “Veracity Explanation”, “Filters”, “Overall Summary”, “Clarity and Simplicity”, “Relevance Explanation”, “FC Summary”, and “Relevant FCs”. The vertical axis, labeled “Number of Participants”, represents a linear scale ranging from 0 to 6, with tick marks at integer intervals. Each criterion is represented by a single bar filled with a shade of blue or green. The “Veracity Explanation” and “Filters” criteria both have bars of approximately length 1, while “Overall Summary” and “Clarity and Simplicity” have bars of approximately length 2. The “Relevance Explanation” bar reaches a length of 3, the “FC Summary” bar reaches a length of 5, and the “Relevant FCs” bar has the greatest length with a value of 6. The bars are sorted alphabetically by criterion label, and no bars are visually emphasized through shading, bolding, outlining, or annotation.
